description: Format edited files or native Codex patch destinations with available prettier, gofmt, rustfmt, or black, then report trailing whitespace and YAML syntax errors. Requires jq.

hooks.command: command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "ogxo-format: jq not found; this hook is inactive. Install jq to enable it." >&2; exit 1; }; bash "${PLUGIN_ROOT:-${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}}/hooks/format.sh"
